metadata.interpretation: Suggestions require user confirmation; complete-case combined scores assume all offered suggestions are accepted. Not measured product success.
metadata.annotation: New agent-authored references, frozen before inference, not user-reviewed. Prior benchmark test was already inspected.

protocol.name: Rules first; model suggests one object only on empty rule selection
protocol.annotationPolicy: Required groups and optional supports fixed before inference; not reviewed by user.
protocol.existingResults: comparison.json may be replayed for exploratory reference only; not used for tuning.
protocol.gate: rules.selected.length === 0; partial nonempty selections are unchanged
protocol.candidate: highest cosine score among available objects, after excludedObjectIds from current rules
protocol.simpleFallback: top1 with threshold 0.20, no margin gate; fixed before experiment
protocol.objective: useful primary suggestions - 2 * non-useful suggestions on calibration fallback cases only; ties: fewer non-useful, more useful, higher absolute threshold, higher margin
protocol.usefulSuggestion: Not abstention reference, no forbidden objects and covers at least one required group. Optional support alone is not a useful primary suggestion.
protocol.interpretation: Suggestion requires user confirmation; combined scene success is hypothetical acceptance, not automatic product success.
